baseline.modeled_quantity_basis: One exported active component record per modeled instance; not bodies, folders, purchased quantities or suppressed components.

quantity_policy: Original modeled counts, stable CAD IDs and instance names are immutable in this additive file.
owner_proposed_quantity is an owner-proposal count only. It is separate from final_required_quantity, purchased_quantity and purchased_part_number, which remain null.
Null quantity means unstated/unresolved; it must never be converted to zero or inferred from holes, pictures, suffixes or CAD body counts.
Arithmetic deltas compare only stated families under a conditional role match; they are not approved purchase increments.
No separately named CAD row means no top-level named record was identified, not that hardware is absent from bought/custom imported assemblies.
Retained/reused stock screws are existing hardware; subset reuse is not an extra purchase.
Alternative supplied/candidate PSU screws and USB cables/adapters must not be summed as mandatory items.
CAD source-named part numbers are evidence of naming only; purchased identity/specification remains unconfirmed.
Assembly order and routes are owner proposals. This record validates no fit, pinout, thermal gap, power connection, service action or physical procedure.
